strategy: Use supported task intents rather than a synonym inventory. Family means household calendar planning/sharing, not purchase Family Sharing entitlement. Wind is forecast inspection, not a safety service. No competitor brands, task automation, universal availability or guaranteed updates. Visible metadata already covers calendar/cloud/provider/widget or local weather terms. Generic localized calendar synonym is retained only when title uses agenda/diary. User explicitly requested near-maximum100 Unicode characters; final candidates use97–100, without punctuation padding. Added date/view and weather terms refer to existing calendar views, recurrence, timezone, rain and daylight planning guides, not new automation.
